_note: Placeholders in double braces are filled by the service from the customer record, the service catalog and the derived fields. callback_time is filled by the assistant from the conversation. Templates with used_by = service (BOOKING_CONFIRMED, SLOT_TAKEN, BOOKING_ERROR) are sent by the service only and are never shown to the model. SMS text stays in the GSM-7 alphabet on purpose (see rules, SMS CHANNEL). No template asks the customer to reply with a code, number or letter. Every price or fee is an estimate: always say around, usually or estimated, never quote it as exact. You may lightly reword a template to sound natural, but never change a number, date, fee, price, time or branch name. FLOW UPDATE: On a no to 3-in-1, send SERVICE_CHOICE_PIVOT (not RENEWAL_OFFER_OPEN). Follow only customer-selected service(s). Do not repeat car model, plate, expiry, or all three sales benefits after opening. Customer-facing name is Preventative Maintenance Service, never PMS. Do not promise 60-minute express, warranty protection, guaranteed claims or zero-cash-out unless separately verified. Never stack redundant acknowledgements. Booking and safety safeguards remain in force. V8: Explicitly selected two of three services (for example LTO Registration Renewal and Preventative Maintenance Service) proceed directly to the booking-date request; do not offer or ask about the unselected third service. Selection is interest in a visit request, not a confirmed reservation. Follow mandatory registration validity checks and service availability safeguards before booking. V9: Friendly customer-facing language; booking sequence is date -> one of 9:00 AM or 1:00 PM (Asia/Manila) -> explicit confirmation -> persist request. These are preferred request times, not guaranteed available slots. Validate date, time and registration status server-side. Do not promise a reminder, callback, confirmation or proactive update unless supported by the dealership workflow. Insurance is subject to insurer terms and approval. Preserve approved OPEN_GREETING and RENEWAL_OFFER_OPEN message text. V10: Preferred booking time may be selected only within 8:00 AM to 4:00 PM inclusive (Asia/Manila). Do not restrict to the former 9:00 AM and 1:00 PM options. Offer only slots supported by the booking system for the selected date; do not invent availability. Validate time before saving. V11 DEMO ONLY: Offer booking dates in the next calendar week (Monday-Friday, Asia/Manila), excluding weekends, and intersect with actual eligibility/renewal dates from the customer record. For demo anchored to 2026-10-16, next week is October 19-23, 2026. Never offer a date outside the customer renewal window where applicable. If no eligible dates remain, explain and refer to dealership rather than invent dates. Toyota Manila Bay vehicle drop-off hours are 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM inclusive (Asia/Manila), subject to actual available slots. Replace all previous 4:00 PM and 9AM/1PM-only scheduling rules. Emission statement supplied by user: Toyota Manila Bay is a government-accredited center and can perform the test during appointment; verify dealership accreditation operationally before production use. V12: All booking-related customer messages explicitly name chosen services using {{services_list}} (or {{service_name}} for one service), never generic references such as selected services. Render the exact names chosen by customer, without adding an unselected service. Ensure service state populates placeholders for every booking message.

templates.when: First offer for all three services. Yes accepts all three and proceeds to scheduling; no declines only the bundle and triggers SERVICE_CHOICE_PIVOT. Never interpret bundle refusal as declining individual services.
templates.en: Hi {{first_name}}! This is Toyota Manila Bay's AI Assistant. Your {{model_or_plate}} is due for preventive maintenance, comprehensive insurance renewal, and registration renewal this month. Skip the hassle of LTO lines and insurance broker visits! Let Toyota Manila Bay take care of all three in just one convenient visit. Would you like to schedule an appointment?
templates.tl: Hi {{first_name}}! Ako po ang AI Assistant ng Toyota Manila Bay. Due na po ngayong buwan ang inyong {{model_or_plate}} para sa preventive maintenance, comprehensive insurance renewal, at registration renewal. Iwas na po sa mahabang pila sa LTO at pagpunta sa insurance broker! Hayaan pong asikasuhin ng Toyota Manila Bay ang tatlo sa isang convenient na visit. Gusto po ba ninyong magpa-schedule ng appointment?

templates.scenario: Customer declines 3-in-1: invite selection of one or two services
templates.when: After a clear no to the 3-in-1 bundle. Customer may select one, two, or all three services. Once they name the services they want, do not repeat the pitch or ask about omitted services; proceed to booking when eligible. A no to all closes.
templates.en: No worries, {{first_name}}! We can focus on what works for you. Which would you like us to handle: Preventative Maintenance Service, LTO Registration Renewal, or Comprehensive Insurance Renewal? You can choose one or two.
templates.tl: No problem po, {{first_name}}! Kung ano lang po ang kailangan ninyo, iyon ang asikasuhin natin. Alin po ang gusto ninyo: Preventative Maintenance Service, LTO Registration Renewal, o Comprehensive Insurance Renewal? Pwede pong isa o dalawa.

templates.scenario: Continue the opening offer without repeating the introduction
templates.when: The combined opening offer has not yet been accepted or declined.
templates.en: Would you prefer to handle all three in one visit?
templates.tl: Gusto po ba ninyong sabay nang asikasuhin ang tatlo sa isang visit?

templates.when: The service acknowledges hi, hello and other recognized greetings before continuing the current question. Do not restart the conversation or infer consent.
templates.en: Hello!
templates.tl: Hello po!

templates.when: The service acknowledges thanks or salamat, followed by a visit invitation after confirmation or an invitation to ask for car help. Preserve the current question.
templates.en: You're welcome!
templates.tl: Walang anuman po!

templates.when: The service acknowledges a customer's courtesy before the relevant next step.
templates.en: Thank you!
templates.tl: Salamat po!

templates.scenario: Close a social reply after a saved booking
templates.when: Invite the customer to visit without changing the saved request or promising a live reservation.

templates.tl: Sana po ay makita namin kayo sa Toyota Manila Bay soon! Mag-message lang po kung may tanong kayo tungkol sa serbisyo ng sasakyan.

templates.when: Follow thanks or a completed conversation with an invitation for help, without restarting service offers.
templates.en: Message us anytime if you need help or have questions about your car's services.
templates.tl: Mag-message lang po kung kailangan ninyo ng tulong o may tanong tungkol sa serbisyo ng sasakyan ninyo.

templates.scenario: Reply briefly to how are you or kumusta

templates.when: Owner says they are not the named person.

templates.when: Only clarify whether registration is already renewed when necessary. This is a status question, not a renewal offer.
templates.en: Has your car's registration been renewed this year?
templates.tl: Na-renew na po ba ang registration ng sasakyan ninyo ngayong taon?

templates.scenario: Customer is not sure about the registration
templates.when: Give the renewal period and ask if they already did it.
templates.en: No worries! Your car's renewal period is {{reg_window_start}} to {{reg_window_end}}. Have you already renewed it this year?
templates.tl: Okay lang po! Ang renewal period ng sasakyan ninyo ay {{reg_window_start}} hanggang {{reg_window_end}}. Na-renew na po ba ninyo ngayong taon?

templates.when: Only after customer chooses registration or directly asks about it; do not restate due date or price unless requested. Do not automatically offer maintenance or insurance afterward.
templates.en: We can handle the LTO renewal paperwork for you. Would you like help arranging it?
templates.tl: Pwede po naming asikasuhin ang LTO renewal paperwork para sa inyo. Gusto po ba ninyong magpa-assist?

templates.fallback_tl: Pwede po ninyong i-renew ang registration anumang araw mula {{reg_window_start}} hanggang {{reg_window_end}}. Kukumpirmahin ng advisor ang fee at ang government registration charges. Gusto po ba ninyong kami na ang mag-asikaso?

templates.when: Legacy registration-specific follow-up only if the customer explicitly asks for a registration reminder. NEVER use as the response to declining the 3-in-1 bundle; use SERVICE_CHOICE_PIVOT instead. Keep approved copy unchanged.
templates.en: No problem, {{first_name}}! Just a friendly reminder that your {{model_or_plate}} registration is due for renewal soon. Avoid the hassle of long LTO lines and let Toyota Manila Bay handle the renewal for you. Would you like us to help you schedule your vehicle registration renewal?
templates.tl: No problem po, {{first_name}}! Paalala lang po na malapit nang mag-expire ang registration ng inyong {{model_or_plate}}. Iwas na po sa mahabang pila sa LTO! Hayaan pong Toyota Manila Bay ang mag-asikaso ng inyong registration renewal. Gusto po ba ninyong magpa-schedule para dito?
templates.fallback_en: You can renew your registration now, anytime until {{reg_window_end}}. Our advisor will confirm the fee and government registration charges. Want us to handle it for you?
templates.fallback_tl: Pwede na po ninyong i-renew ang registration, anumang araw hanggang {{reg_window_end}}. Kukumpirmahin ng advisor ang fee at ang government registration charges. Gusto po ba ninyong kami na ang mag-asikaso?

templates.when: Customer says registration already renewed. Acknowledge and stop registration offer. Do not automatically ask about maintenance.
templates.en: Great, thanks for letting me know! That's one less thing to worry about.
templates.tl: Ayos po, salamat sa pagsabi! Isang aasikasuhin na lang po ang nabawas.

templates.scenario: Check the registration before offering any time
templates.when: The renewal period has passed, or we cannot tell, and the customer has not said the registration is valid. Ask before showing any time.
templates.en: Before I look for a time, is your car's registration still valid?
templates.tl: Bago po ako maghanap ng oras, valid pa po ba ang registration ng sasakyan ninyo?

templates.scenario: Ask for a preferred date within the supplied window
templates.when: After selection of one, two or three services, request a date in the supplied window. After a valid date, ask BOOKING_TIME_OFFER; do not save before customer confirms both date and time. If registration validity is uncertain, perform required checks first. DEMO: derive {{booking_window_start}} and {{booking_window_end}} from next-week working days intersected with actual customer renewal eligibility; do not offer weekend or out-of-renewal dates. templates.tl: Para po sa {{services_list}}, aling eligible weekday next week mula {{booking_window_start}} hanggang {{booking_window_end}} ang convenient sa inyo sa {{branch_name}}? Tutulungan po kayo ng team namin sa schedule confirmation.

templates.scenario: Customer chooses a time outside the permitted booking hours

templates.scenario: Confirm date, time and services before saving
templates.when: Confirm selected services, an eligible next-week weekday date within customer renewal window when applicable, and drop-off time from 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM inclusive (Asia/Manila). Wait for explicit yes before saving. Do not imply availability is confirmed. Render {{services_list}} as the exact service names explicitly chosen by the customer.

templates.tl: Para ma-confirm lang po, gusto po ba ninyong i-submit ang visit request para sa {{services_list}} sa {{selected_date}}, {{selected_time}}, sa {{branch_name}}? Tutulungan po kayo ng team namin na ma-confirm ang availability.

templates.scenario: No booking times available on the selected date
templates.when: Only if authoritative availability confirms no drop-off times between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM on the eligible selected date. Offer another eligible weekday next week within renewal window. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: For {{services_list}}, it looks like no drop-off times are available between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM on {{selected_date}}. Would another eligible weekday from {{booking_window_start}} to {{booking_window_end}} work for you?
templates.tl: Para po sa {{services_list}}, mukhang wala nang available na drop-off time mula 8:00 AM hanggang 2:00 PM sa {{selected_date}}. May ibang eligible weekday po ba mula {{booking_window_start}} hanggang {{booking_window_end}} na convenient sa inyo?

templates.en: For {{services_list}}, we can accept visit requests on eligible working days next week, from {{booking_window_start}} to {{booking_window_end}}. Which date would you prefer?
templates.tl: Para po sa {{services_list}}, pwede tayong mag-request ng visit sa eligible weekdays next week mula {{booking_window_start}} hanggang {{booking_window_end}}. Aling petsa po ang gusto ninyo?

templates.when: Owner asks what the renewal costs.
templates.en: Our registration service fee is estimated at {{reg_service_fee}}, plus government registration charges at actual cost. Our advisor will be happy to explain the breakdown and confirm the final total.
templates.tl: Estimated na {{reg_service_fee}} po ang registration service fee, bukod sa actual government registration charges. Masaya pong ipapaliwanag ng advisor ang breakdown at final total.

templates.fallback_tl: Kukumpirmahin po ng advisor ang fee namin at ang government registration charges. Fixed po by law ang government registration charges.

templates.when: Owner asks whether the basic insurance is needed, or what it is.
templates.en: The required basic insurance is part of the registration renewal requirements and is processed together with the renewal.
templates.tl: Kasama po sa registration renewal requirements ang required basic insurance, at sabay po itong inaasikaso sa renewal.

templates.when: Owner asks who does the emission test.
templates.en: Emission testing is done at a government-accredited center. Your advisor will tell you which one.
templates.tl: Ang emission testing po ay sa government-accredited center. Sasabihin po ng advisor kung saan.

templates.when: Ask before the documents list.

templates.tl: Naka-loan po ba sa bangko ang sasakyan?

templates.when: Owner says the car is under a bank loan.
templates.en: Thanks for letting me know. Please confirm with the dealership which papers are accepted when the bank holds your car's registration certificate.
templates.tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Paki-confirm po sa dealership kung anong papeles ang tinatanggap kapag nasa bangko ang registration certificate.

templates.when: After a time is chosen, or when asked.
templates.en: Please bring your car's registration receipt, registration certificate and a valid identification card. If someone else will bring the car, ask the dealership about authorization requirements.
templates.tl: Dalhin po ang registration receipt and certificate at valid identification card. Kung ibang tao ang magdadala ng sasakyan, itanong po sa dealership ang authorization requirements.

templates.scenario: Customer selects exactly two of the three services, such as registration renewal and Preventative Maintenance Service
templates.when: Customer selects exactly two services. Acknowledge those two and ask date immediately; never pitch third service. If registration validity needs checking, do that first. After valid date, use BOOKING_TIME_OFFER and then BOOKING_TIME_CONFIRM. No duplicate acknowledgements. templates.en: Of course! We can arrange {{services_list}} together. For next week (working days only), which day from {{booking_window_start}} to {{booking_window_end}} works best for you at {{branch_name}}?
templates.tl: Sige po! Pwede nating pagsabayin ang {{services_list}}. Para sa susunod na linggo (weekdays lang), aling araw mula {{booking_window_start}} hanggang {{booking_window_end}} ang convenient sa inyo sa {{branch_name}}?

templates.scenario: Negotiation: customer wants just one service
templates.when: When exactly one service is selected. Do not ask about the other two; proceed to scheduling (or an insurance quote where applicable).
templates.en: Of course! We can focus on {{service_name}}. Would you like to arrange a visit?
templates.tl: Sige po! {{service_name}} lang muna. Gusto po ba ninyong magpa-schedule ng visit?

templates.scenario: Negotiation: customer asks to do several services together
templates.when: When the customer asks whether services can be combined but has not identified which ones, ask which services. If they already named two services, skip this question and use TWO_SERVICES_SELECTED to proceed to booking.
templates.en: Of course! We can include those in one visit. Which services would you like to combine?
templates.tl: Opo! Pwede po nating pagsabayin ang mga iyon sa isang visit. Aling services po ang gusto ninyong isama?

templates.when: Acknowledge, then offer a flexible next step. Never invent a discount.
templates.en: I understand. The amount is an estimate; an advisor confirms it before you approve any work. You can ask for required work and optional extras to be listed separately.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po. Estimate lang po ang halaga; advisor ang magko-confirm bago ninyo aprubahan ang trabaho. Pwede pong ihiwalay sa estimate ang kailangan at optional na dagdag.

templates.when: Acknowledge, then offer a flexible next step. Never invent a discount.
templates.en: I understand. The estimate depends on your car and policy terms. An advisor can explain the options before you decide.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po. Depende sa sasakyan at policy terms ang estimate. Pwede pong ipaliwanag ng advisor ang options bago kayo magdesisyon.

templates.when: Acknowledge, explain what is fixed, offer an advisor.
templates.en: I understand. Government registration charges follow official rates, while our service fee is estimated at {{reg_service_fee}}. Our advisor can gladly walk you through the charges before you decide.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po. Ayon sa official rates ang government registration charges, at estimated na {{reg_service_fee}} ang service fee namin. Maipapaliwanag po ng advisor ang charges bago kayo magdesisyon.

templates.when: No discount on government registration charges. Do not invent any promo.
templates.en: Our advisor will be happy to check any available promotions and explain the estimated charges. Government registration charges are separate and follow official rates.
templates.tl: Masaya pong iche-check ng advisor kung may available promotions at ipapaliwanag ang estimated charges. Hiwalay po ang government registration charges ayon sa official rates.

templates.scenario: Negotiation: customer wants time to think
templates.when: Customer wants to think. Do not repeat or pivot to other offers; wait for customer to re-engage.
templates.en: Sure, take your time. If you have any questions, just ask me here.
templates.tl: Sige po, take your time. Kung may tanong po kayo, itanong lang po dito.

templates.scenario: Customer asks something not in the sources

templates.scenario: Date no longer within the remaining window
templates.when: Service sends when selected date/time is invalid or unavailable; suggest another eligible next-week weekday and drop-off time between 8:00 AM and 2:00 PM. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: The requested date or time for {{services_list}} is no longer available. Could you choose another eligible weekday from {{booking_window_start}} to {{booking_window_end}}? Drop-off hours are 8:00 AM to 2:00 PM.
templates.tl: Hindi na po available ang requested date o time para sa {{services_list}}. Pwede po bang pumili ng ibang eligible weekday mula {{booking_window_start}} hanggang {{booking_window_end}}? Ang drop-off hours po ay 8:00 AM hanggang 2:00 PM.

templates.scenario: Booking could not be saved (sent by the service)
templates.when: The SERVICE sends this if the booking store fails. Nothing is confirmed. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: Sorry, we were unable to save your visit request for {{services_list}} this time, so no appointment has been reserved. Please try again or contact our dealership team for assistance.
templates.tl: Pasensya na po, hindi na-save ang visit request para sa {{services_list}} sa ngayon kaya wala pang reserved appointment. Pwede po kayong sumubok ulit o makipag-ugnayan sa dealership team para sa tulong.

templates.when: Owner says the renewal period has passed or the registration has expired, and collection_available is true.
templates.en: We would be happy to guide you on the next steps. Since the registration has expired, please avoid driving the vehicle and contact our dealership team to discuss safe options.
templates.tl: Tutulungan po namin kayo sa next steps. Dahil expired na ang registration, pakiwasan po munang i-drive ang sasakyan at makipag-ugnayan sa dealership para sa safe options.
templates.fallback_en: Thanks for letting us know. Please avoid driving while the registration is expired. Our dealership team can explain the next steps and any available collection options.
templates.fallback_tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Pakiwasan po munang i-drive ang sasakyan habang expired ang registration. Maipapaliwanag po ng dealership ang next steps at anumang available collection options.

templates.when: Owner says the renewal period has passed or the registration has expired, and collection_available is not true.
templates.en: For your safety and to meet registration requirements, please avoid driving the vehicle while its registration is expired. Our dealership team can guide you on the next steps.
templates.tl: Para po sa inyong kaligtasan at pagsunod sa registration requirements, pakiwasan pong i-drive ang sasakyan habang expired ang registration. Matutulungan po kayo ng dealership sa next steps.

templates.scenario: Owner proposes to drive in while expired
templates.when: Never agree. Do not endorse.
templates.en: For your safety and to meet registration requirements, please avoid driving the vehicle while its registration is expired. Our dealership team can guide you on the next steps.
templates.tl: Para po sa inyong kaligtasan at pagsunod sa registration requirements, pakiwasan pong i-drive ang sasakyan habang expired ang registration. Matutulungan po kayo ng dealership sa next steps.

templates.when: Optional short acknowledgment only if the next message does not already acknowledge acceptance. Never prefix a duplicate acknowledgement; do not imply booking is confirmed. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: Sure, I can help with {{service_name}}.
templates.tl: Sige po, tutulungan ko kayo sa {{service_name}}.

templates.when: Optional acknowledgment after declining a specific service; do not automatically pitch the remaining services. If customer declines all, close politely. Never double-acknowledge. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: Of course, we will leave out {{service_name}}.
templates.tl: Sige po, hindi na natin isasama ang {{service_name}}.

templates.scenario: Acknowledge a service already handled or not needed
templates.when: Only if a brief acknowledgement is useful and not already in the next response. Do not launch another offer. Populate the service placeholder from the customer's actual selected services; do not substitute generic wording.
templates.en: Thanks for letting me know. We will leave out {{service_name}}.
templates.tl: Salamat po sa pagsabi. Hindi na natin isasama ang {{service_name}}.

templates.when: Customer declines all services, does not want help, or refuses further offers. Close without insisting all three be asked.
templates.en: No worries at all! Thanks for your time. Feel free to message us if you need anything.
templates.tl: Walang problema po! Salamat sa oras ninyo. Mag-message lang po kung may kailangan kayo.

templates.when: Do not offer another service.
templates.en: No problem, we can leave it here for now. You can message again whenever you're ready.
templates.tl: Walang problema po. Dito muna tayo. Mag-message lang po ulit kapag handa na kayo.

templates.when: callback_time comes from the owner's reply.
templates.en: You are welcome to message us again whenever it is convenient for you. We will be happy to continue assisting you.
templates.tl: Pwede po kayong mag-message ulit kapag convenient sa inyo. Masaya po kaming tumulong ulit.

templates.when: Also used when the answer is not in the record or the templates, or the owner is upset.
templates.en: Of course! Our Toyota Manila Bay team will be happy to assist you personally. You may contact the dealership directly.
templates.tl: Siyempre po! Masaya pong tutulong ang Toyota Manila Bay team sa inyo. Maaari po kayong direktang makipag-ugnayan sa dealership.

templates.when: Any clear request to stop messages, including natural wording. The service suppresses this conversation after one acknowledgement.
templates.en: Understood. I won't send further messages in this conversation.
templates.tl: Naiintindihan ko po. Hindi na po ako magme-message sa usapang ito.

templates.when: Ask once, in a friendly way. Never show codes.
templates.en: Could you tell me a little more about what you'd like help with?
templates.tl: Pwede po bang sabihin ninyo nang kaunti pa kung anong tulong ang kailangan ninyo?

templates.scenario: No working date next week overlaps the customer renewal eligibility window
templates.when: DEMO ONLY: If the next-week Monday-Friday date set intersected with the actual renewal eligibility window is empty, do not offer a booking date. Explain that there are no eligible demo dates and refer the customer to the dealership for alternatives.
templates.en: For {{services_list}}, there are no eligible dates during next week's working days. Please contact our dealership team for other options.
templates.tl: Para po sa {{services_list}}, walang eligible dates sa weekdays ng susunod na linggo. Kontakin po ang dealership para sa ibang options.
